name: CoherenceSoftRefit
registered: 2026-10-23, before any development metric of the new rule was computed
question: Can neighbour-trace support reduce the background noise left by SoftGroupRefit while keeping the weak reflections it recovered?
rule: gain_jk = E_jk / (E_jk + lambda(c_jk) V_jk), lambda(c) = lambda_min + (lambda_max - lambda_min) (1 - c)^2. E, V, support, Q, wavelet, sigma and refit amplitudes are exactly those of SoftGroupRefit; only the gain changes.

coherence.source: Unshrunk FullCalRefit group contributions W r_g of the neighbouring traces (never the shrunk output, truth, model names or event lists).
coherence.neighbours: half_width = 2 traces each side, whole 99-trace gather (block edges no longer matter).
coherence.alignment: For each neighbour at distance m, lags |l| <= m * ceil(dip_periods / (f dt)) with dip_periods = 0.25; a neighbour group is a candidate when its centre lies within that bound plus half a period.
coherence.score: max over candidate groups and lags of max(0, rho) * min(beta, 1/beta); rho = normalised correlation, beta = amplitude projection ratio (must be positive).
coherence.aggregation: side support = mean score of that side's neighbours; c = max(left side, right side), so a reflector ending at a fault or pinch-out keeps one-sided support.
coherence.fallback: lambda = 1 (existing soft rule) for every group of a trace that is dead or has a dead trace within +-2 traces, or has fewer than 2 neighbours. Dead = all-zero trace (data-only).

development.data: The 20 soft_refit_20261023 scenes (four-layer and complex model, Moderate/Strong, Q -30/-10/0/+10/+30%), reusing their cached FullCalRefit checkpoints. These are already-seen development data.
development.selection: Feasible if the mean (over the 10 four-layer scenes) of weak-amplitude-error ratio candidate/soft <= 1.02. Among feasible, minimise the equal-weight mean over all 20 scenes of overall-error ratio candidate/soft; candidates within 0.5% of the best prefer the smaller lambda_max, then the larger lambda_min. If none is feasible, report and do not freeze a winner.
development.frozen_ablations: NoAlign: selected lambdas with dip_periods = 0 (lag 0 only). UniformLambda: constant lambda equal to the median lambda realised on the development set by the selected rule, applied without coherence. Both frozen with the winner.

data: V1 four-layer model, original geometry, new noise seeds 2026102401 (Moderate 14 dB) / 2026102402 (Strong 8 dB).
V2 new four-layer variant FaultPinch: new event times, amplitudes, dip, true Q, a fault (time throw) and a weak reflector that pinches out; seeds 2026102411/2026102412.

V3 new complex model (MATLAB port of the complex_fieldlike generator, new geology seed 2026102421 and changed fault, channel, wedge and lens positions), independent 18 dB calibration with the frozen layered-calibration code; noise seeds 2026102431/2026102432.
validation.Q: Q -30/-10/0/+10/+30% relative to true Q (V1, V2) or to the calibrated Q (V3). Support, Q, wavelet, sigma and observation are shared by every method in a scene.
validation.metrics: overall relative error; weak-amplitude error (V1, V2; Ricker-template projection at registered weak events); fault-neighbourhood error, pinch-out region error (V2, V3); low-energy region error and deep-window error (V3). Truth is used only for scoring.

acceptance.A1_overall: equal-weight mean over all validation scenes of overall-error ratio CoherenceSoftRefit/SoftGroupRefit <= 0.95
acceptance.A2_weak: mean weak-amplitude-error ratio vs soft over V1+V2 scenes <= 1.02
acceptance.A3_fault: mean fault-neighbourhood error ratio vs soft over V2+V3 scenes <= 1.02
acceptance.A4_pinchout: mean pinch-out region error ratio vs soft over V2+V3 scenes <= 1.02
acceptance.A5_Q_under: mean overall-error ratio vs soft over all Q -30% and -10% scenes <= 1.00
acceptance.note: Proposed targets from the user's plan; not achieved gains. Failing any gate means the rule is not promoted. Thresholds are not changed after validation data are seen.

limits: Same simulator family (quasi-1D convolution); not real data or full-wave validation. Scenes share models, so they are not independent samples; no significance claims.
